_instructions: Map each sticker/packaging type to the Shopify product title keywords that use it. A product is matched to the FIRST type whose keywords all appear in the product title (case-insensitive). Products that don't match any type are placed in '_unmapped' in the report.
_note: Edit the packaging_types above to match YOUR actual sticker types and the keywords found in your Shopify product titles. You can add or remove types as needed.
